title: Prospect Data Engine (PDE)
shortDescription: A high-throughput ETL engine processing large multi-gigabyte Excel datasets with worker threads, chunked streaming, configurable batching, and fault-tolerant checkpoint resume.
overview: Prospect Data Engine is engineered to solve memory saturation and crash loops when parsing massive, heterogeneous Excel (.xlsx/.csv) files containing hundreds of thousands of lead prospects. Traditional single-threaded parsers choke or exceed Node.js heap limits. This engine distributes file parsing across Node.js worker thread pools, streams rows into validated batches, and provides real-time progress telemetry with persistent crash-recovery checkpoints.
problem: Operations teams routinely deal with 500k+ row Excel workbooks that freeze standard spreadsheet tools and crash conventional web application upload endpoints due to synchronous in-memory parsing and V8 garbage collection spikes.
solution: Architected a streaming ETL pipeline that splits incoming workbooks into byte chunks, distributes decompression across worker threads, validates records against configurable schemas, and persists state markers every 1,000 processed rows for instant resumption.

features.title: Multi-Threaded Parallel Ingestion
features.description: Offloads CPU-heavy parsing and unzipping of XLSX binaries to worker thread pools, keeping the main event loop completely unblocked.

features.title: Streaming Batch Processing
features.description: Buffers incoming records into tuneable batch windows with backpressure controls to prevent database connection exhaustion.

features.title: Checkpoint-Based State Recovery
features.description: Persists atomic ledger markers per chunk; if network or process drops occur, parsing resumes from the exact last verified line.

features.title: Dynamic Schema Validation
features.description: Dynamic field mapping, regex sanitization, and automated anomaly isolation that exports corrupt rows into dedicated audit logs.

contributions: Engineered the multi-threaded orchestration layer utilizing Node.js `worker_threads` and shared memory buffers.
Implemented a custom stream transformer with backpressure signaling that reduced memory spikes from 2.4 GB to under 180 MB.
Designed the idempotent checkpoint recovery protocol with transactional state tracking in Redis and PostgreSQL.
Built an intuitive dashboard for operators to monitor job queues, view health metrics, and trigger re-runs.

challenges.title: V8 Heap Exceeded on Monolithic XLSX Files
challenges.challenge: Parsing full XML DOM trees inside .xlsx zip packages exhausted the default Node.js memory limit on files over 150MB.
challenges.solution: Switched to an event-driven SAX parser combined with Node.js Readable streams, processing raw sheet XML nodes sequentially without constructing the full document tree in memory.

challenges.title: Database Lock Contention During Bulk Upserts
challenges.challenge: Worker threads executing uncoordinated bulk inserts caused deadlocks and row-lock contention on customer tables.
challenges.solution: Implemented a publisher-consumer queue with Redis Streams that aggregates validated records into sorted micro-batches with staging table bulk COPY commands.
